recap.text: Dwight, a level-87 sparkling unicorn enchanter, is sized up by Carl on the road, and the System says his horn is valuable. At the Lollipop, Dwight stabs the gremlin DJ in the face with it as Carl is handed a microphone to sing Take On Me. In the last heat, Donut, as smoke, takes his head with one swipe of her claw, and his horn lands in her inventory.

beats.headline: Grab the horn
beats.text: Team Sparkles stops in the road, and Carl examines the bigger of the two: Dwight, a level-87 sparkling unicorn enchanter. A sparkling unicorn, the System says, is pretty much a unicorn, but it sparkles because even more magic permeates it. Their horns are quite valuable to certain parties, so if Carl kills him, he should grab the horn as quickly as possible. Most unicorns are known for their gentle manner. But not Dwight.
beats.gist: Carl examines Dwight, a level-87 sparkling unicorn enchanter whose horn is valuable.

beats.headline: Stabbed into the DJ
beats.text: At the Lollipop the gremlin DJ has been on the floor yelling at Dwight, who still has not moved. The DJ goes back to his booth and calls up Princess Donut and Carl to sing Take On Me, slaps a microphone into Carl's palm, and the screens say Get Ready to Sing. Carl reads his scroll. The synth pop starts, the crowd cheers, the gauges appear. And that is when Dwight the unicorn stabs the DJ in the face with his horn.
beats.gist: Dwight the unicorn stabs the DJ in the face with his horn as the song starts.

beats.headline: Into Donut's inventory
beats.text: At the green light of the last heat, it goes for Dwight exactly as planned. He bursts off the line dragging his missile cart and fires his cannon into Bruna, whose shield is already up. The hole punch, the vine-killing potion balls and the GPS-frying potion all do their jobs, and Donut goes out the passenger window as smoke, onto the roof of the truck. Dwight's head comes off in a single swipe of her claw. Before the notification even arrives, his magical horn has been removed from his head and placed in her inventory.
beats.gist: Dwight's plan works: Bruna removes his head with one claw swipe and his horn goes into her inventory.
